series_ref_conventions.old_url:<path>: container that tree_plan must create (sidebar tree node, unmatched)
series_ref_conventions.tmp:series:NNN: container created by a create_series op in THIS plan
series_ref_conventions.tmp:lesson:NNN: row created by an insert_lesson op in THIS plan
series_ref_conventions.lesson_ref_old: row whose insert is owned by another scope plan (resolve after all inserts)

vocabulary_extensions.publish_lesson: {lesson_id, reason} — inverse of draft_lesson; old public page shows a draft row
vocabulary_extensions.insert_lesson.payload.tmp_id: lets later copy/sort ops reference the inserted row

_meta.sort_semantics: set_lesson_sort{lesson_id, series_ref, sort_order}: applies to the row living in series_ref after moves/copies (per-(lesson,series) row). sort_order = old item idx * 10.
_meta.canonical_rule: canonical page of an item = best old-listing occurrence ranked by (non-aggregate first, deepest path, page-series == lesson.series, url). Aggregate = tree alias OR page mapped to the same series as a shallower page. Other scope plans must use the same rule for cross-plan insert ownership to be consistent.
